title: The first little piece
intro: Fiocco is afraid of falling and tries anyway, one little piece at a time. At home you pick something new and real from the day and do only its beginning: this activity is done without the tablet.

6-7.goal: Start something new by doing only its first little piece, even if it doesn't work straight away.
steps: Choose together a small new thing the child wants to do (tie a shoe, pour the milk, write their name).
Ask: "What's the first little piece?" and let the child say it.
The child says "I'll try" out loud and does only that piece.
If they want to go on, they go on; if they stop, that's fine: tomorrow they start from the next piece.
materials: whatever the chosen thing needs, nothing more
preparation: Think of a real moment of the day when the child hesitates: no need to invent one.

supervision.note: Stay close and don't correct while they try. If they ask for help, help with that step and leave the next one to them.

alternatives: If there's nothing new, a usual thing done a new way (with the other hand, alone instead of together).
If saying "I'll try" out loud is embarrassing, they can whisper it or give a thumbs up.
